questions.question: Write down the three properties of eigenvalues and eigenvectors under a Hermitian transformation. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Write down the three properties of eigenvalues and eigenvectors under a Hermitian
  • transformation. [U/CO3]
  • Answer:(i) Eigenvalues are real. (ii) Eigenvectors of distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal.
  • (iii) The eigenvectors form a complete set, so the matrix can be diagonalised by a unitary
  • transformation. –3 Marks

  • (U1U2)(U1U2)† =U 1U2U †2 U †1 =U 1U †1 =I

  • e.g.I+I= 2Igives(2I)(2I) † = 4I̸=I. The sum is NOT unitary in general. –2 Marks
  • (b)(AB) † =B †A† =BA, soABis Hermitian only ifAB=BA. Hence the product of two
  • Hermitian matrices not necessarily be a Hermitian matrix;
